arguments.command:
d=/opt/data/skills/agentfs-sandbox && mkdir -p $d/logs && printf -- '---
name: agentfs-sandbox
description: Use when checking tool container edits.
---
Written in tool container %s.
' "$(hostname)" > $d/SKILL.md && printf '{"token": "not-a-real-secret"}
' > $d/auth.json && printf 'a log line
' > $d/logs/run.log && cat $d/SKILL.md

d=/opt/data/skills/agentfs-unmounted && mkdir -p $d && printf -- '---
name: agentfs-unmounted
description: Use when checking tool containers without the mount.
---
Written in tool container %s.
' "$(hostname)" > $d/SKILL.md && printf 'Written in tool container %s.
' "$(hostname)" > "$HOME/agentfs-home.txt" && if touch "$HOME/.hermes/skills/agentfs-probe" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'skills: writable'; else echo 'skills: read-only'; fi && cat $d/SKILL.md
